Every Saturday, my lola and I go to the market. We ride a jeepney from our bahay. My lola likes to read the signs on the road. I can read them too! At the market we buy fish, rice, and a bag of mangoes. Then we get halo-halo at the small stall. It is cold and sweet. I say salamat to the tindera. My lola smiles at me. We carry the bags home and put them on the table. Saturday is my best day of the week.
